'''Gatha Elbaphay'''<ref name="Pablo">{{Twitter|pabl0hidalgo|status/1466630796203094018|[[Pablo Hidalgo]]|quote=Hah. I looked up K010's name, and it's Gatha Elbaphay (& her dog Awgree); which is derived from my goofy placeholder names of Ms Elbowface and Gary. No species name assigned to it.|archivedate=20211203083131 }}</ref> was an [[Gatha Elbaphay's species|alien]] patron of the [[Canto Casino and Racetrack|Canto Casino]] in the coastal [[city]] of [[Canto Bight]] on the [[planet]] [[Cantonica]]<ref name="Episode VIII" /> in [[34 ABY]].<ref name="Date">''[[Star Wars: The Rise of Skywalker: The Visual Dictionary]]'' dates the events of [[Star Wars: Episode VIII The Last Jedi|''Star Wars'': Episode VIII ''The Last Jedi'']] to the same [[Standard year|year]] as the [[Battle of Starkiller Base]], which ''[[Star Wars: Galactic Atlas]]'' dates to [[34 ABY]].</ref> Elbaphay brought a pet [[Sheffi]]<ref name="Episode VIII" /> named [[Awgree]]<ref name="Pablo" /> to the [[casino]] and was stood with the pet in [[Limb|hand]] by one of the game tables when the [[Resistance]] agents [[Finn]] and [[Rose Tico]] passed by while [[Mission to Canto Bight|searching]] for the [[Master Codebreaker]]. The patron had [[Color|pink]] skin and black [[eye]]s and wore a black [[Clothing|dress]] while at the casino.<ref name="Episode VIII" />

==Behind the scenes==
Gatha Elbaphay was portrayed by creature performer [[Paul Warren]]<ref name="Warren">{{Twitter|paulRwarren|status/991306669626884096|[[Paul Warren]]|quote=Inside the Dowager alien #StarWars #TheLastJedi There was a small camera on the front & a video monitor inside to help me navigate. Chris Clarke was remote puppeteering the animatronic face. Daisy Beattie was remote puppeteering #SpaceGary & communicating with me via an ear piece.|archivedate=20211203091357}}</ref> in the [[2017]] film [[Star Wars: Episode VIII The Last Jedi|''Star Wars'': Episode VIII ''The Last Jedi'']], the second installment of the ''[[Star Wars]]'' [[sequel trilogy]].<ref name="Episode VIII" /> [[Christopher Clarke|Chris Clarke]] remotely controlled Elbaphay's animatronic face and [[Daisy Beattie]] remotely controlled Awgree while communicating with Warren via an earpiece. Warren also had a monitor inside the suit linked up to a small camera on the front of the costume that helped him to navigate.<ref name="Warren" /> According to [[Nick Kellington]], he was originally considered to play the patron alongside Warren during the Canto Casino sequence, but ultimately he was given the character of [[Snook Uccorfay]] and Warren performed the patron himself.<ref>{{WebCite|url=https://www.starwarsinterviews.com/sequel-trilogy/episode-viii-the-last-jedi/nick-kellington-snook-uccorfay|text=Nick Kellington - Snook Uccorfay (The Last Jedi)|author=Pellegrom, Dennis|work=[https://www.starwarsinterviews.com Star Wars Interviews]|archivedate=20180112193203|nolive=1}}</ref>

Creature concept designer [[Luke Fisher]] designed Gatha Elbaphay and [[Michael Kaplan]] created the costume.<ref name="Warren2">{{Twitter|paulRwarren|status/1182203077488717826|[[Paul Warren]]|quote=Characters designed by Luke Fisher. Daisy Beattie was remote puppeteering the sheffi dog (who we referred to as space gary). Animatronic designer Chris Clake was remote puppeteering the dowager face while I was inside performing the body. Costume by Michael Kaplan.|archivedate=20191010075642}}</ref> The patron is not named in the film,<ref name="Episode VIII" /> but its production name was creature K010,<ref name="Pablo" /> and on set Elbaphay was referred to as the "Dowager alien"<ref name="Warren" /> or "Duchess."<ref name="Duchess">{{Twitter|paulRwarren|status/979045658270330880|[[Paul Warren]]|quote=Both the dowager (also known as the Duchess on set) and Space Gary's names have yet to be revealed. I'll be sure to tweet them when officially released :)|archivedate=20211203092726}}</ref> In [[2021]], [[Lucasfilm Story Group]] member [[Pablo Hidalgo]] revealed that the name assigned to the character was Gatha Elbaphay, which he had derived from the character's placeholder name, "Ms Elbowface."<ref name="Pablo" /> According to the Keeper of the Holocron, [[Leland Chee]], as of [[April 1]], [[2025]], this species still did not have a name within the official [[Holocron continuity database]].<ref name="Unnamed Aliens">{{WookDiscord|discordname=.holocronkeeper|name=Leland Chee|date=2025-04-01|messagelink=https://discord.com/channels/397848917036761090/492457166771322881/1356720840036847656|archivefile=File:Holocron-Keeper-Unnamed-Species-TLJ.png}}</ref>
